name: threadline
description: Runs the Threadline seller, admin, customer and delivery apps locally.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix shared install && npm --prefix seller/backend install && npm --prefix admin/backend install && npm --prefix user/backend install && npm --prefix delivery/backend install && npm --prefix seller/frontend install && npm --prefix admin/frontend install && npm --prefix user/frontend install && npm --prefix delivery/frontend install
scripts.seed: npm --prefix seller/backend run seed:sellers && npm --prefix seller/backend run seed:catalog
